$comment: Machine-readable acceptance ledger (ТЗ 10/10 rev2 §22, §18.3). One entry per program milestone: status, requirement/evidence lists, blocking issues, waivers and the accepted commit. A milestone whose status is NOT 'accepted' must not be treated as a completed stage: downstream milestones may proceed only with evidence that this ledger records. No user consent, debug mode or high-risk grant can override a blocked requirement. Ordering gate (audit 'CI gate blocking M2 while M1.status != accepted'): a milestone may only be marked 'accepted' when EVERY earlier milestone is 'accepted'; scripts/check-milestone-gates.mjs --check enforces this in CI. A milestone whose works are shipped but whose predecessors are not yet accepted is recorded as 'in_progress' with a 'deliveredCommit'.
